notablePrerequisites:
You have the highest life total.
You control at least one basic Swamp.
description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Pestilence by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Each Polyraptor you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Polyraptor.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an untapped Polyraptor, untapping the basic Swamp.
Repeat.
